name: Image Cropper
summary: Crop PNG, JPEG, or WebP images with aspect presets and pixel controls — in your browser.
description: Upload an image, choose a crop region with sliders or aspect presets (1:1, 16:9, 4:3), preview the result, and download. All processing stays on your device.

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Cropping runs entirely in your browser with the Canvas API.

faqs.question: Which aspect ratios are supported?
faqs.answer: Free crop plus 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, and 3:2 presets centered on the image.

faqs.question: Which formats can I export?
faqs.answer: Keep the source format, or export as JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
